meta.name: dbt-transformation-patterns
meta.description: Master dbt (data build tool) for analytics engineering with model organization, testing, documentation, and incremental strategies. Use when building data transformations, creating data models, or implementing analytics engineering best practices.

copy.tagline_en: Master data modeling conventions to keep transformation pipelines clean and maintainable
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build data transformation pipelines regularly

howto.what: 你请 Claude 写或改 dbt 模型时,它会按 staging/intermediate/marts 分层组织模型,用各层对应前缀命名,并给出测试、文档、增量策略和项目配置示例。
howto.when: 当你要用 dbt 构建数据转换、创建数据模型,或实施分析工程最佳实践时触发。

say.text: 帮我建 stg_payments 模型,清洗 stripe 源表。
say.note: 会给出 staging 层 SQL 和配置说明。

say.text: 给项目模型加 not null、unique 测试,补上描述。
say.note: 会给出写测试和文档的 yml 示例。

say.text: 订单表已超 100 万行,帮我配成增量模型。
say.note: 会给出增量物化配置和注意点。

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to create or edit dbt models, it organizes them into staging/intermediate/marts layers, applies the matching layer prefix, and provides examples for tests, docs, incremental strategy, and project config.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you are building dbt data transformations, creating data models, or implementing analytics engineering best practices.

say_en.text: Build a stg_payments model to clean the Stripe source.
say_en.note: It will show staging SQL and config notes.

say_en.text: Add not-null and unique tests to the models, plus descriptions.
say_en.note: It will give a YAML example with tests and docs.

say_en.text: The orders table is over 1M rows; make it incremental.
say_en.note: It will explain incremental materialization and caveats.
